title: Seva
sub: Border tax, WhatsApp group aur bhi bahut kuch

wa.title: Humara WhatsApp Group
wa.step1: Neeche button dabao aur ye message {number} pe WhatsApp karo.
wa.step2: Humari team isi chat mein aapko group ka link bhejegi.
wa.step3: Link kholke join request bhejo — request turant approve hogi aur aap group mein jud jaoge.
wa.sub: Humara WhatsApp group — wahi rides, seedha WhatsApp pe
wa.needProfile: Group join karne se pehle profile poori karein — admin aapko naam se approve karte hain.
wa.sameNumber: Message usi WhatsApp number se bhejo jisko group mein jodna hai.

bt.title: Border Tax
bt.periodEnd: {mode} — period khatam hone tak valid (date govt portal set karta hai)
bt.declare: Main confirm karta hoon ki gaadi ki details sahi hain aur sarkari portal ka declaration maanta hoon.
bt.freeNote: Members ke liye free — aap sirf sarkari tax bharte hain, official payment page par.
bt.historyEmpty: Aapki border tax filings yahan dikhengi.

filling.s: Aapke liye sarkari portal bhara ja raha hai

awaiting_captcha.s: Aage badhne ke liye dikhaya code likhein

handed_off.s: Payment ho gaya? Official site se receipt lein

failed.s: Yeh filing poori nahi ho saki

cancelled.s: Aapki request cancel ho gayi hai

awaiting_payment.s: Kisi bhi UPI app se pay karein

fail.captcha_timeout: Code time par nahi likha gaya. Dobara file karein.
fail.captcha_wrong: Code kai baar galat hua. Dobara file karein.
fail.portal_error: Sarkari portal mein dikkat hai. Kuch minute baad try karein.
fail.worker_restart: Sarkari portal mein dikkat hai. Kuch minute baad try karein.
fail.state_unsupported: Yeh state abhi available nahi hai.
fail.vehicle_pending: Is gaadi ka ek payment sarkari site par adhoora hai. Lock hatne ke baad dobara bharein.
fail.already_paid: In dates ka tax pehle se bhara hai. Doosri date chunein.
fail.road_tax_expired: Gaadi ka road tax khatam ho gaya hai. Renew karke dobara bharein.
fail.same_state: Yeh gaadi isi state ki hai — yahan border tax nahi lagta.
fail.no_tax_mode: Is border par is gaadi ka tax option nahi hai. RC mein gaadi taxi (MOTOR CAB / MAXI CAB) hai ya nahi, check karein.
fail.bank_down: State ki payment site abhi down hai. Thodi der baad try karein.
fail.portal_down: Sarkari border tax site abhi down ya bahut slow hai. Thodi der baad try karein.
fail.no_handoff: Sarkari site ne payment page nahi khola. Dobara try karein.
fail.pucc_expired: Gaadi ka pollution certificate (PUC) expire ho gaya hai. Renew karke dobara bharein.
fail.insurance_unverified: Govt portal gaadi ka insurance confirm nahi kar paya. Dobara try karein. Baar baar ho to apni policy check karein.
fail.fitness_expired: Gaadi ka fitness certificate expire ho gaya hai. Renew karke dobara bharein.
fail.seat_class_mismatch: RC mein gaadi ki class aur seats match nahi karti, isliye online tax nahi bhara ja sakta. RTO se RC theek karwayein ya border par tax bharein.
fail.vehicle_not_found: Sarkari Vahan site par yeh gaadi number nahi mila. RC se number check karein.
fail.no_qr: Sarkari payment page par QR nahi aaya. Thodi der baad try karein.
fail.treasury_down: Sarkari payment site abhi down hai. Thodi der baad try karein.
fail.payment_failed: Payment nahi hui. Koi doosra UPI app ya bank account try karein. Paise kat gaye hon to support se baat karein.
fail.payment_timeout: Time par payment nahi mila. Pay kar diya hai to dobara na karein — support se baat karein.
fail.payment_unknown: Payment confirm nahi hua. Pay kar diya hai to dobara na karein — support se baat karein.
fail.alreadyPaidS: {from} – {to} ka tax pehle se bhara hai. Iske baad ki date chunein.
fail.fare_declined: Aapne fee dekh kar filing rok di. Jab chahein dobara file karein.

live.captchaSub: Hamara reader yeh code nahi padh saka. Jaisa dikhe waisa hi likhein, # ya @ bhi.
live.closedSub: Payment link lagbhag 5 minute chalta hai. Agar payment nahi kiya, to portal gaadi ko lagbhag 30 minute rok kar rakhta hai — uske baad dobara file karein.

gate.title: Seva members ke liye hai
gate.sub: Border tax aur humara WhatsApp group membership ke saath free hai.

errors.vehicleBusy: Is gaadi ki ek filing pehle se chal rahi hai — History dekhein.
errors.rateLimited: Bahut zyada filings. Ek ghante baad try karein.
errors.generic: Shuru nahi ho saka. Dobara try karein.
errors.busy: Govt site busy hai. {time} mein dobara try karein
errors.portalDown: Sarkari border tax site abhi band hai. Chalu hote hi aapko notification aa jayegi.
errors.vehicleLocked: Is gaadi ki pichhli payment abhi govt site par khuli hai. {time} tak free ho jayegi. Hum notification bhejenge.

prep.title: Aapka border tax payment taiyaar ho raha hai
prep.verify: Gaadi ki details check ho rahi hain
prep.fetch: Payment details li ja rahi hain
prep.redirect: Payment par bheja ja raha hai
prep.keepOpenS: Ye screen band na karein. Payment details yahin apne aap aa jayengi.
prep.queued: Thodi der mein shuru hoga — govt site har 2 minute mein ek check allow karti hai
prep.startsIn: {time} mein shuru — govt site har 2 minute mein ek lookup allow karti hai

pay.title: Payment Details
pay.note: Official sarkari payment page naye tab mein khulega. Link lagbhag 5 minute chalta hai. Agar pehle sarkari treasury page khule, toh wahan Continue dabayein. EaseCab kuch charge nahi karta.

fee.mine: Is cab ki pichli fee is state mein: {amount}, {n} din

fare.label: Sarkari fee
fare.sub: Aage badhke payment na milne par sarkari site gaadi ko lagbhag 30 minute lock kar deti hai.

qr.title: Border Tax bharein
qr.scan: Seedha UPI se pay karein — doosre phone se scan karein, ya isi phone par Pay dabayein.
qr.wait: Pay karne ke baad yeh screen khuli rakhein — aapki govt receipt yahin aayegi.
qr.noReceipt: Payment ho gaya, par govt receipt nahi aayi. Support se baat karein, hum nikaal denge.
qr.saveHint: Abhi apne phone mein save kar lo — hum ise {date}, {time} ko EaseCab se hata denge.
qr.receiptGone: Tax validity khatam hone ke 24 ghante baad receipt EaseCab se hata di gayi. Phone mein save ki hui copy use karo.
qr.gettingReceipt: Payment ho gaya. Govt site se aapki receipt la rahe hain…
qr.expired: QR ka time khatam. Check kar rahe hain ki payment aaya ya nahi…
qr.verifying: Agar aapne pay kar diya hai, toh thoda intezaar karein — aapki receipt govt portal se nikaali ja rahi hai. Isme kuch minute lag sakte hain.
qr.noRepay: Dobara pay mat karein. Ye screen khuli rakhein ya baad mein Border Tax history mein receipt dekhein.
qr.scanCaps: Kisi bhi UPI app se scan karke pay karein
qr.beforeT: Timer khatam hone se pehle pay karein
qr.beforeS: Time par pay nahi kiya to yeh QR band ho jayega aur govt site is gaadi ko lagbhag 30 minute rok degi, uske baad hi dobara file kar payenge.

unlock.error: Start nahi hua. Ek minute baad try karo.
unlock.queued: Govt portal pe lock hata rahe hain…
unlock.waiting: Portal ye gaadi {time} pe chhodega, tab lock hat jayega. Agar aapne portal pe khud pay kiya hai, to dobara pay na karein.
unlock.cleared: Lock hat gaya. Ab dobara file kar sakte ho.
unlock.paid: Pichla payment ho chuka tha. Receipt no. {no}
unlock.failed: Lock nahi hat paya. Support se baat karo.

issues.vehicle: Sahi gaadi number daalein, jaise PB10AB1234
issues.sameState: Yeh gaadi isi state mein registered hai — border tax sirf doosre state ki gaadiyon ke liye hai.
issues.start: Aaj se 7 din ke andar ki date chunein
issues.declare: Confirm wale box pe tick karein

confirm.title: Tax validity confirm karein
confirm.sub: Is start date se tax sirf neeche wali date tak valid rahega.

late.title: Border tax bhar gaya
late.sub: {vehicle} ({state}) ki payment mil gayi. Receipt tayyar hai.

bt.siteDown: Sarkari border tax site abhi band hai. Chalu hone tak filing nahi hogi.
